title: Equilibrium Transformative Cleansing Balm
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Phthalates✓ Without Parabens✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Without Sulfates SLS & SLES
What it is: An ultra-nourishing balm-to-oil cleanser that effortlessly melts away makeup, sunscreen, and impurities, leaving skin looking hydrated and radiant.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness

Formulation: Balm

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hourglass Amnio Youth Lipids: Support natural cell turnover and replenish moisture.
- Sunflower Seed and Avocado Oils: Hydrate and nourish skin.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, mineral oil, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This non-comedogenic formula trans
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Using the spatula, scoop out a small amount and apply to dry skin.
-Gently massage into skin, paying special attention to areas where dirt, oil, and makeup
accumulate.
-Rinse with warm water or wipe off with a damp washcloth.
-Store in a cool, dark place.
Ingredients+
-Hourglass Amnio Youth Lipids: Support natural cell turnover and replenish moisture.
-Sunflower Seed and Avocado Oils: Hydrate and nourish skin.

Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate, Synthetic Wax, PEG-10 Isostearate, Trihydroxystearin, Cedrus Atlantica Bark Oil, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Linalool, Limonene, Salvia Sclarea (Clary) Oil, Phospholipids, Lecithin.
